annotation.title_clean: Enhancing worker health and safety through AI-driven systems: implications of the Artificial Intelligence Act
annotation.title_en: Enhancing worker health and safety through AI-driven systems: implications of the Artificial Intelligence Act
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Agency for Safety and Health at Work (EU-OSHA)
annotation.summary_en: EU-OSHA publication page for a 19-page discussion paper on how the EU AI Act affects AI-driven occupational safety and health systems, focusing on prohibitions, exceptions and ambiguities. It stresses that AI Act compliance alone does not ensure lawful workplace use, given other EU and national law.
key_provisions_or_claims: Paper examines AI Act opportunities and challenges for AI-driven OSH systems.
Focuses on prohibitions, exceptions and ambiguous areas.
AI Act complements existing EU and national legislation.
Compliance with the AI Act alone does not guarantee lawful workplace use.
